scope: Real released native game processes on one Windows computer, loopback system-link, scripted player input and native impact-damage/forced-kill hooks. No MCC game protocol, public host, Spark listing-to-client flow, human play, projectile-flight/aiming, full inventory/object parity, AI agreement or player-scale certification.

observedPrerequisite.issue: UI plus selected Blood Gulch was insufficient for native fast-host setup; the exact releases open stock Carousel first.
observedPrerequisite.resolution: Add unchanged owned carousel.map. Public QA preflight now refuses it when missing before copying or launching processes.
observedPrerequisite.firstAttempt: opence-same-2 loaded UI but did not host/join; both timed exits normal. Not counted as game acceptance.

analysisProcedure.exit0Meaning: Selected sampled fields agree, not perfect gameplay.
analysisProcedure.exit2Meaning: Refused, missing simulation or observed sampled-state disagreement.

departure.note: Continued ticks and app exit receipts are separate from a graceful in-game leave, reusable lobby, active match or reconnect acceptance. A retained dead entry without an increased death count is not an additional combat death.

limitations: Upstream SHOOT cues apply native weapon-impact damage; they do not establish trigger input, projectile flight, aiming or visible firing. KILL cues separately force a scoring death.
Scripted player input is not human gameplay or campaign AI. Sampled counters do not certify complete state, physics, animation, rendering, audio, scale or multiplayer limits.

Position differences are measured without a pass threshold. Grenades, ordered weapon records and item count differences remain explicit; role-local cumulative counters need not equal. A score of -1 can mean that the game has no score callback, so equal -1 values do not establish scoring behavior.

No signed Delta compatibility table or local runtime/content attestation is supplied or accepted here. A same-runtime run cannot authorize OpenCE/Chupathingy mixed compatibility or relax the listing gate.
